title: Wyjście z piwnicznego salonu
description: Wyjście z piwnicznego salonu. Owczar jest wyżej, Dariusz idzie za nim. Kontynuacja już rozpoczętego wspinania; bez obejmowania na wąskich schodach. Montaż 2 s; ewentualne źródło 3 s.

prompts.image: Use case: sketch-to-render / photorealistic-natural. Create ONE final live-action film still, 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. Input 1 is a WORKING BLENDER RENDER, strictly a camera, spatial layout, scale and composition reference, NOT the final visual style. Input 2 is a SMALL PERSPECTIVE/BLOCKING GUIDE of the same camera: its converging lines explain real spatial directions and its primitive figures mark human placement. Do not reproduce the guide, linework, captions, faceted bodies, plastic surfaces or crude geometry. Rebuild the visible scene as a convincing photographed physical place while retaining the prescribed viewpoint, major dimensions, openings, object positions and framing. Improve natural material variation, construction details, contact shadows and realistic light; do not redesign the layout or invent different architecture. No game-engine look, no illustration, no split panels, no watermark. Early-1990s provincial Polish atmosphere, understated cinematic realism and restrained film grain, no modern products. Input 3 is the exact production identity and wardrobe reference: Dariusz is the chubby red-brown wavy-haired boy with rectangular dark glasses on the LEFT of that reference; Owczar is the slim dark-blond boy in the burgundy track jacket on its RIGHT. Both are 13–14, clean-shaven. Preserve their specific faces, hair, age, body shape and clothing. Owczar has TWO cream stripes on each sleeve, ivory T-shirt, loose blue jeans and worn pale canvas trainers. Dariusz has an open grey-blue plaid overshirt, grey/navy striped T-shirt, dark loose jeans and dark worn trainers. Their positions in the final shot are dictated by the shot instructions, not by the identity reference layout. Replace all visible primitive stand-ins with anatomically natural boys, and insert the boys where requested even if the clean render is empty. No adult beard, no extra people. SHOT ACTION AND COMPOSITION: Two boys climbing the basement stairs away from camera, single file. Owczar leads higher up; Dariusz follows one or two steps below. Each foot firmly on a real stair; arms free, no embrace on stairs. Soft urban overcast daylight, believable worn materials and subtle dirt without theatrical decay. Keep the same natural atmosphere across the street and shop sequence.  Input 4 is the completed exterior establishing shot, for continuity of the boys and natural photographic material/light ONLY. It must NOT replace the viewpoint, architecture or crop of input 1. No coin display or copied pose from the identity sheet; follow THIS shot action.
prompts.animation: 0.0–2.0s: Both boys are already climbing away from camera. Owczar, higher on the stairs, takes two ordinary upward steps; Dariusz follows one to two steps behind without overtaking. Each foot lands on a separate existing tread before weight transfers. 2.0–3.0s: Continue the same natural ascent toward the landing. Camera: locked at the foot of the stairs. Sleeves and loose jeans sway slightly with the steps. @Image1 fixes the boys identities and clothing only; preserve the rear view, stair dimensions, rails and daylight from the Start Frame. No embrace, sliding feet, stair deformation, turning toward camera, new people or cuts.
